descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Get on board and be part of an enthusiastic team that takes ownership of the technical solution, keeps a strict eye on quality and maintains a strong relationship with the client. You will join the product team of a Western European company that runs a software platform in the e-mobility and energy sector, used daily by operators and drivers. The platform is in production and evolves continuously, and the team uses AI-assisted development as a core, organized and secure part of how it builds software. We are looking for people who love what they do, take initiative and know how to use AI as a multiplier for their engineering work.
 If you'll join us, you will... 
have a direct contribution to a platform used in production by real operators and end users
work embedded in the client's product team, alongside their tech lead, product manager and developers
solve complex technical challenges in a domain with real business complexity
use AI-assisted development daily, in a professional and secure way
build a long-term collaboration, with the possibility to move between product teams
get direct exposure to the client
have access to various growing programs
work with passionate colleagues
have flexibility to work from home according to our hybrid policy
 You'll get to play with... 
PHP
Symfony
REST APIs consumed by external clients and mobile applications
MySQL
Docker
AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, used in an organized and secure workflow
AWS (nice to have)
 You will be involved in... 
understanding business and functional requirements together with the client's product manager and tech lead
design and implementation of backend features and APIs in PHP / Symfony
evolving a platform that combines legacy components with APIs used by external clients, with care for backward compatibility
using AI tools throughout the development cycle (analysis, implementation, tests, documentation) while keeping full ownership of the result
reviewing and validating AI-generated code against coding guidelines, security and quality standards
code reviews according to agreed coding guidelines and best practices
analysis and fix of reported issues
proposing technical improvements and better ways of working with AI in the team
 What are we looking for 
3 to 5+ years of experience with PHP, including Symfony
hands-on experience building and maintaining REST APIs in production, ideally with external consumers
solid knowledge of OOP, software design principles and relational databases (MySQL)
proven experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar): you know when to use it, how to prompt it well and how to check its output
a professional and secure approach to AI: no sensitive data in prompts, no unreviewed generated code in production
autonomy and ownership: you take a topic from requirements to production
strong analytical and problem-solving skills
proficiency in written and spoken English and good communication skills, as you will work directly with the client's team
proactivity when working remotely with a team that is mostly on-site
 Nice to have 
experience with AWS
experience in e-mobility, energy, IoT or B2B integrations with standardized protocols
experience working embedded in a client's team
 About Yonder: Yonder has been developing software for 32 years, for the most prominent software companies. Collaboration is key, with the product software company as domain specialist and Yonder as technology specialist. In our team we are fully responsible for the technical solutions and quality of the delivery, while we manage to keep a very strong relationship with the client and you’re a key player in doing so.
 Apply now! *Please note that by applying to this role you are informed about your personal data being processed by Yonder for recruiting purposes.You can find more details about our privacy policy here.
